basis: Carries the 15-Jan hardened/dispersed regional pool forward through continued US Gilbert pressure, repair/replacement flow and late defense cargo. Does not import the old Jan-28 OOB unchanged.

sensor_C2.Taroa: A-grade warning/plot node; intact chain commonly yields about 20-35 min useful preparation, not precision GCI.
sensor_C2.Kwajalein_Roi: A-/B+ HQ/air/water-air plot with improved lagoon warning, alternate power and telephone routing.
sensor_C2.Wotje_Mili_Jaluit: B+/B distributed warning/DF/radio/water-air nodes; valuable for sector cue and persistence more than fine fighter control.
sensor_C2.Kusaie_Ponape: Rear warning/weather/DF/staging depth; does not create same-morning free Marshall CAP.

operational_note: US land air is steadily suppressing southern/eastern bases, but hardening turns the campaign into repeated runway, fuel, repair and sensor reattack rather than a one-pass aircraft parking-lot kill.
